caseNameFull: John H. Strosnider v. Edmund M. Allen, Warden, etc.
summary: Appeal from the District Court of the United States for the Northern District of Illinois.
attorneys: Mr. Benjamin C. Bachrach for the appellant. Mr. Patrick J. Lucey and Mr. Lester H. Strawn for the appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed with costs upon the authority of Urquhart v. Brown, 205 U. S. 179; Ex parte Spencer, 228 U. S. 652, 659-661; Frank v. Mangum, 237 U. S. 309, 328, 329.
